# Migration from v7 to v8

Migration guide from v7 to v8

## Overview

- **Category**: migration
- **Base Library**: custom

## About

This is a documentation page. Please refer to the [Netline UI Storybook](https://netline-ui-storybook-next.aks-netline.dev.lhsystems.int) for complete information.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { MigrationV7toV8 } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<MigrationV7toV8>
  Content
</MigrationV7toV8>
```
